summary: Completed live frontend flow testing for CareerPeek. Home, careers directory, search/empty state, detail pages, roadmap navigation, milestone expansion, LinkedIn link configuration, explore-more navigation, browser back, and mobile overflow passed.
seed_data_creation: None; static career data is intentional for V1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Critical live UI flows covered at desktop and mobile widths. No API integration exists by design. One initial broad test selector counted image test IDs as cards; corrected test selector passed.
rca of the issue: No application issue reproduced. The first run's failed assertion was caused by the test selector [data-testid^=career-card-] also matching career-card-image-* elements; exact/non-image card selection resolved it.
